name: AlgHom.funLike._proof_1
typeText:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring.{u_1} R] [inst_1 : Semiring.{u_2} A]
  [inst_2 : Semiring.{u_3} B] [inst_3 : Algebra.{u_1, u_2} R A] [inst_4 : Algebra.{u_1, u_3} R B]
  (f g : AlgHom.{u_1, u_2, u_3} R A B),
  Eq.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} (OneHom.toFun.{u_2, u_3} ↑↑(AlgHom.toRingHom.{u_1, u_2, u_3} f))
      (OneHom.toFun.{u_2, u_3} ↑↑(AlgHom.toRingHom.{u_1, u_2, u_3} g)) →
    Eq.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} f g
